title: Q2 Flightpath: Staggered SLA & Prioritization Matrix for Hosted API Model Catalog
creator: Diego Morales
description:
Objective: Define and operationalize a quarter-long 'Flightpath' that prescribes staggered latency SLAs per model tier and a prioritization matrix that maps customer cohorts, traffic fractions, and rollout canary windows for the Hosted API model catalog.

Why now: Q2 model lineup expansion plus capacity variability requires deterministic rollout plans that protect latency-sensitive customers while enabling rapid model on-ramps for low-latency tolerant cohorts. This ticket bridges product prioritization, runbook triggers, and canary scheduling with capacity hedges.

Scope:
- Produce a prioritization matrix that ranks models by SLA tier, cost-sensitivity, and compatibility for auto-fallback variants.
- Define staggered SLA targets (latency P50, P95) for three hosted tiers: Stableline (SLA), Flightline (reduced latency), and Explorers (best-effort).
- Specify canary windows, traffic ramp schedules, and rollback triggers tied to observability signals (error rate, latency, token cost).
- Map customer cohorts (lighthouse, enterprise, self-serve) to rollout lanes and required communications.
- Deliver decision rules for automatic variant fallback (e.g., quantized vs full-precision models) when capacity breaches thresholds.

Out of scope: private deployments, deep kernel optimization work (ENG tickets will handle runtime tuning), and long-term model catalog pruning policies.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Prioritization matrix completed and reviewed by Eng, Sales, and Customer Success. 2) SLA definitions documented with measurable signals and thresholds. 3) Canary schedule and traffic ramp playbook uploaded to Confluence with owner assignments. 4) Auto-fallback mapping table exists that references model variant keys and runtime compatibility notes. 5) Stakeholder sign-off recorded and runway handoff to ENG for automation implementation.
notes: Design constraint: avoid hard SLOs for Explorers tier; favor outcome-based guidance.
We will default to model-variant fallback order: stable-quantized -> stable-fp16 -> flightline-fp16 -> fallback-small. Exact keys delegated to model-onboarding team.
Estimate assumes one cross-functional workshop and two review cycles.
Tiebacks: coordinate with Pricing for any tiered cost messaging and with Console team for dashboard slices.
